SELECT id, customer_name, qualification_type, expiration_date, user_name, attachment_id, create_time, audit_status, remark FROM t_customer_qualification
is_deleted = #{param.is_deleted}
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%'#{param.customerName}'%')
AND qualification_type LIKE CONCAT('%'#{param.qualificationType}'%')
AND expiration_date LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.expirationDate},'%')
AND user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.userName},'%')
AND attachment_id = #{param.attachmentId}
AND create_time LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.createTime},'%')
AND audit_status LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.auditStatus},'%')
AND remark LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.remark},'%')
